name: @h081lll/mcp

tools.name: h081_bank_deposit
tools.description: Deposit USDG from the agent wallet into its private (shielded) H081 bank account on Solana. The chain sees the depositor and the amount; the shielded balance and every later move inside the bank are private. Caps (read from chain before any proof is made): at most 1,000 USDG per deposit and 10,000 USDG in the bank in total; deposits can be paused by the config authority, withdrawals never. Needs ~0.02 SOL in the agent wallet for buffer rent (refunded) and fees. Give `amount` (base units, 6 decimals) or `usdg` (decimal). H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

inputSchema.description: exactly one of amount (base units) or usdg (decimal)

tools.name: h081_bank_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw USDG from the shielded account to a Solana wallet (default: the agent wallet). By default the relayer sends the transaction and takes its fee out of the amount: max(0.05 USDG, 0.20%) of the public amount, paid to the protocol treasury (checked before anything is proven); the chain then does not link the agent wallet to the withdrawal. If the relayer is unreachable or refuses, the withdrawal is NOT sent and the error says why; it is never silently sent by the agent key. Above the relayer's anonymous free tier (100 USDG per 30 days today) the agent wallet is named to the relayer as capacity operator, which needs H081 staked in capacity_stake (`h081_stake`); otherwise split the withdrawal or go direct. `direct: true` has the agent key send it instead (no relay fee, no limit, but the agent wallet is visible on chain as the sender). Give `amount` or `usdg`. H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

to.description: recipient wallet (default: the agent wallet); must be a wallet, not a token account or program

direct.description: true: the agent key sends the withdrawal itself (no relay fee, no free-tier limit, sender visible on chain); default false: through the relayer, refused (not sent) when the relayer is unavailable

inputSchema.description: exactly one of amount (base units) or usdg (decimal)

tools.name: h081_bank_balance
tools.description: The shielded USDG balance of the agent's H081 bank account (visible only to this key), the wallet's public USDG and SOL balances, the current deposit caps, and every allowance with its id and limits: `agentAllowances` (granted to this account; h081_pay spends them), `subAccounts` (granted by this account to its sub-accounts; h081_pay spends them with agentIndex), `heldBySubAccounts` (delegated to a sub-account from an allowance someone else owns; h081_pay with agentIndex) and `grantedToOthers` (granted to other agents; theirs to spend). `reclaimable: true` marks the ones this account owns (h081_allowance_reclaim). Ids are what h081_pay, h081_allowance_delegate and h081_allowance_reclaim take as `allowanceId`; an id changes after every payment or delegation. Also `shieldedAddressCode`: this account's shielded address as an "h081-address:" code, to hand to whoever should pay it privately (h081_pay) or grant it an allowance. Read-only.

tools.name: h081_loan_quote
tools.description: Price a stream-backed loan without sending anything. From a lender's `h081-loan-terms:` code (or `pledgeBps` and `minRemaining` directly) it returns the largest principal that pledge can back (minRemaining * pledgeBps / 10000), the 0.25% origination fee the protocol takes out of the payout, and the payout. With `loanRef` it also reads the slot's on-chain status (funded, principal, repaid, expiry). There is no on-chain offer book: terms come from a lender off-chain. Read-only.

termsCode.description: a lender's "h081-loan-terms:" code (gives pledgeBps and the slot)

minRemaining.description: the allowance budget the proof will state (base units)

pledgeBps.description: share of every payment routed to the lender, basis points

principal.description: a principal to price (base units); default: the maximum

loanRef.description: loan slot number to read on chain

tools.name: h081_loan_borrow
tools.description: Pledge an agent allowance to a lender's loan slot and produce the proof the lender funds against. The agent's shielded balance funds an allowance of `budget` USDG to a sub-account that unlocks as a stream over `unlockDays`, with `pledgeBps` of every payment from it routed to the lender (from the terms code), then makes the stream proof and returns it as an `h081-loan-proof:` code. Hand that code to the lender: when they fund the slot, the principal minus the 0.25% origination fee lands in the agent wallet's USDG account. Give `principal` to borrow a set amount: the proof fixes it and the program lets the lender fund exactly that, nothing else. The lender's share runs over the whole budget, so with a principal the budget is sized to it (principal * 10000 / pledgeBps) and a bigger budget is refused: it would let the lender take more than it lent. With only `budget`, the principal is the most it can back. This is a two-party flow with no automatic matching: without a lender who funds, nothing is borrowed (a lender agent opens the slot and funds it with h081_lend). Needs the grant (44 MB) and stream circuits. H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

budget.description: allowance budget taken from the shielded balance (base units); with a principal: default and maximum principal * 10000 / pledgeBps

dailyCap.description: most the sub-account may pay per day (base units); default: no daily cap

maxPerTx.description: most per payment (base units); default: no per-payment cap

principal.description: the loan amount asked for (base units): the lender must fund exactly this; at most budget * pledgeBps / 10000. Default: that maximum

days.description: lifetime of the allowance in days

unlockDays.description: the budget unlocks linearly over this many days (<= days)

agentIndex.description: which sub-account to use (default: the first free one)

inputSchema.description: a budget (budget or budgetUsdg) and/or a principal (principal or principalUsdg); with a principal the budget defaults to exactly what it needs and a larger one is refused

tools.name: h081_stake
tools.description: capacity_stake: stake H081 from the agent wallet to earn relayer capacity (desks and shield capacity: how much the relayer relays for this wallet per 30 days above the anonymous free tier, used by h081_bank_withdraw), request unstake (30-day cooldown), unstake after the cooldown, or `view` the position. Caps: 100,000 H081 per stake, 1,000,000 H081 total. Give `amount` (base units, 6 decimals) or `h081` (decimal) for stake / request_unstake. H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

amount.description: base units (H081 has 6 decimals), for stake / request_unstake

tools.name: h081_protocol_info
tools.description: Static and live facts about the H081 Capital bank: cluster, program ids, USDG and H081 mints, deposit caps and pause flag read from chain, relayer terms and status, the agent wallet and shielded address (also as an "h081-address:" code others pay with h081_pay), the operator ceilings (H081_MAX_DEPOSIT, H081_MAX_PAY, H081_MAX_GRANT, H081_MAX_LEND), how the shielded account secret is derived, where the proving artifacts live, and the risk notice. Reports only the RPC host, never the full RPC URL. Read-only.

tools.name: h081_pay
tools.description: Pay USDG from an allowance this agent holds: one granted to this account, or (with `agentIndex`) one held by a sub-account. `amount`/`usdg` is taken out of the allowance; a pledged allowance (a loan) routes its lender share (pledgeBps) out of it, the rest is paid. Recipient, exactly one: `to`, a Solana wallet (a public payout: the chain shows the wallet and the amount it received, not which account paid), or `toAddressCode`, the recipient's "h081-address:" code (a private payment from note to note: amount and recipient stay hidden). A public payout goes through the relayer, fee max(0.05 USDG, 0.20% of the amount), plus a surcharge when the wallet has no USDG account yet, to the protocol treasury (checked before anything is proven); if the relayer is unreachable or refuses, the payment is NOT sent, never silently sent by the agent key; above the relayer's free tier (100 USDG per 30 days today) the agent wallet is named as capacity operator (h081_stake). `direct: true` has the agent key send a public payout (no fee; the agent wallet is then visible as the sender). A private payment is always sent by the agent key (no public leg to pay a relayer from): the chain sees that the agent wallet submitted a payment, not to whom or how much. A pledged (loan) allowance is never used unless `allowPledged: true`: paying from it puts its loan slot and lender share on chain next to the payment, which links the recipient to the borrower wallet (the slot's public payout account) and reveals the gross amount. The allowance is `allowanceId` (from h081_bank_balance) or picked automatically: one whose caps allow the amount now (expiry, maxPerTx, remaining, streaming release, per-window cap); when none can, the error names the cap that blocks each one and nothing is sent. Allowances with a recipient allow-list are not supported. The operator ceiling H081_MAX_PAY caps every payment. Returns signature, fee, what the recipient received, and the allowance left. Needs the spend circuit. H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

amount.description: taken out of the allowance (base units); a pledged allowance routes its lender share out of it

to.description: public payout to this Solana wallet (its USDG account); must be a wallet, not a token account or program

toAddressCode.description: private payment to this shielded H081 address: the recipient's "h081-address:" code (h081_bank_balance shows this agent's own as shieldedAddressCode)

allowanceId.description: the allowance to spend, its id from h081_bank_balance (agentAllowances, or subAccounts with agentIndex); default: picked automatically

agentIndex.description: spend an allowance held by this sub-account (default: allowances granted to this account)

direct.description: public payout only. true: the agent key sends it (no relay fee, sender visible on chain); default false: through the relayer, refused (not sent) when the relayer is unavailable

allowPledged.description: default false: a pledged (loan) allowance is never used. true accepts one, whose loan slot and lender share go on chain next to the payment, linking the recipient to the borrower wallet and revealing the gross amount

inputSchema.description: exactly one of amount (base units) or usdg (decimal), and exactly one of to (wallet, public) or toAddressCode (shielded, private)

tools.name: h081_allowance_grant
tools.description: Give a budget (an allowance) from this account's shielded balance to one of its sub-accounts (`agentIndex`, default the first free one) or to another agent (`toAddressCode`, its "h081-address:" code). Limits, all enforced by the circuit on every payment: the lifetime `amount`/`usdg`; optional per-window cap `windowCap`/`windowCapUsdg` per `windowLen` seconds (default 86400: a daily cap); per-payment cap `maxPerTx`/`maxPerTxUsdg`; lifetime `days` (default: no expiry); `unlockDays`: the budget streams in linearly over that many days instead of all at once. This account stays the owner and can take back what is left any time (h081_allowance_reclaim). WITHOUT `confirm: true` NOTHING IS SENT: the result is the plan of exactly what would be granted; call again with confirm: true to send it. The operator ceiling H081_MAX_GRANT caps every allowance. Privacy: the agent key sends it (a grant has no public leg a relayer could take its fee from), so the chain shows that the agent wallet made a grant, not the amount, the rules or the recipient. Needs ~0.1 SOL (buffer rent, mostly refunded) and the grant circuit (44 MB). H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

amount.description: the lifetime budget, taken out of the shielded balance (base units)

agentIndex.description: grant to this sub-account of the agent (default, without toAddressCode: the first free one)

toAddressCode.description: grant to another agent: its "h081-address:" code (its h081_bank_balance shows it as shieldedAddressCode)

windowCap.description: most it may pay per window (base units); default: no window cap

windowLen.description: the window in seconds (default 86400: windowCap is a daily cap)

maxPerTx.description: most per payment (base units); default: no per-payment cap

days.description: lifetime in days; default: no expiry

unlockDays.description: stream: the budget unlocks linearly over this many days (<= days); default: all of it at once

confirm.description: true: send it. Default false: nothing is sent, the result is the plan of exactly what would be granted

inputSchema.description: exactly one of amount (base units) or usdg (decimal); at most one of agentIndex / toAddressCode

tools.name: h081_allowance_delegate
tools.description: Carve a child allowance for a sub-agent out of an allowance this agent holds (`allowanceId` from h081_bank_balance; with `agentIndex`, one a sub-account holds). The child goes to a sub-account (`toAgentIndex`) or another agent (`toAddressCode`, its "h081-address:" code) and can never be looser than its parent, which the circuit enforces and this checks first, naming the limit: `amount`/`usdg` at most what the parent has left; `windowCap`/`windowCapUsdg` and the streaming rate (`unlockDays`) shared with what the parent keeps (default: in proportion to the amount); `maxPerTx`/`maxPerTxUsdg` and `days` no looser than the parent's (default: the parent's); owner, window length, recipient allow-list and any loan pledge are inherited, and the parent's owner can reclaim the child. WITHOUT `confirm: true` NOTHING IS SENT: the result is the plan (the child's rules and what the parent keeps). The operator ceiling H081_MAX_GRANT applies. The agent key sends it (chain sees the agent wallet made a delegation, not amounts, rules or recipient). Needs ~0.02 SOL and the delegate proving artifacts, which the site does not ship yet: put delegate.wasm and delegate.zkey in H081_CIRCUITS_DIR; without them confirm: true is refused before anything is sent (the plan still works). H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

allowanceId.description: the parent: an allowance this agent holds, its current id from h081_bank_balance

agentIndex.description: the parent is held by this sub-account (default: this account; with an id, sub-accounts in use are searched too)

toAgentIndex.description: the child goes to this sub-account

toAddressCode.description: the child goes to another agent: its "h081-address:" code

amount.description: the child's budget (base units), at most what the parent has left

windowCap.description: the child's per-window cap (base units), shared out of the parent's; default: in proportion to the amount

maxPerTx.description: the child's per-payment cap (base units), at most the parent's; default: the parent's

days.description: the child's lifetime in days, never past the parent's expiry; default: the parent's expiry

unlockDays.description: the child unlocks linearly over this many days, never faster than the parent; default: in proportion to the parent's stream (if it streams)

confirm.description: true: send it. Default false: nothing is sent, the result is the plan (the child's rules and what the parent keeps)

inputSchema.description: exactly one of amount (base units) or usdg (decimal), and exactly one of toAgentIndex or toAddressCode

tools.name: h081_allowance_reclaim
tools.description: Take back what is left of an allowance this account granted (to a sub-account or another agent) into its shielded balance: `allowanceId` from h081_bank_balance (`reclaimable: true`; the current id, which changes after every payment). A pledged allowance (a loan) still routes its lender's share (pledgeBps) of what is reclaimed. WITHOUT `confirm: true` NOTHING IS SENT: the result is the plan (amount back, lender share). The agent key sends it (chain sees the agent wallet made a payment, not the amount). Needs ~0.02 SOL and the spend circuit. H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

allowanceId.description: an allowance this account granted (reclaimable: true in h081_bank_balance), its current id

confirm.description: true: send it. Default false: nothing is sent, the result is the plan

tools.name: h081_lend
tools.description: Lend USDG to another agent against its pledged stream (the lender side of h081_loan_borrow), by `action`: "open" a loan slot owned by the agent key (`pledgeBps`, 100..9000: the share of every borrower payment routed to the slot) and get its "h081-loan-terms:" code to hand to the borrower; "fund" a slot against the borrower's "h081-loan-proof:" code (`proofCode`): the code is checked (checksum, network), the proof must be for this slot, USDG and the payout account in the code, not expired, verified locally when stream.vkey.json is present, and backed by a live allowance pledged to this slot; the principal is exactly what the proof backs (the program funds no other amount), leaves the agent wallet's public USDG (not the shielded balance), and the borrower receives it minus the 0.25% origination fee to the protocol treasury; "status" lists the agent's slots (or `loanRef`): funded, repaid, outstanding, claimable, collectable, shortfall, and with `pledgeBps` an open slot's terms code again; "claim" pulls the vested lender share of the borrower's stream (spend circuit); "collect" takes shares already routed to the slot; "settle" closes the books (no shortfall can be reported after); "close" returns a settled slot's rent where the SDK supports it (this build refuses it, nothing sent). WITHOUT `confirm: true` open, fund, settle and close send NOTHING and return the plan. The operator ceiling H081_MAX_LEND caps every loan funded. Risk: repayment is only the pledged share of what the borrower's allowance pays, until the principal is repaid; there is no collateral beyond it. Privacy: stream_loan needs the slot owner's signature, so the agent key sends every lender action (no relayer): the agent wallet is public as the lender, and the principal and payout account are public; the borrower's budget and payments are not. Needs SOL for slot rent and fees (~0.02 SOL to fund). H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

action.description: open a slot, fund it against a borrower proof, status, claim the vested share, collect routed shares, settle, close

pledgeBps.description: open: the share of every borrower payment routed to the slot (basis points). fund: the least share the proof must pledge. status: show an open slot terms code with this share

proofCode.description: fund: the borrower proof code, "h081-loan-proof:..." (from h081_loan_borrow)

loanRef.description: the loan slot number; status without it lists every slot of this agent; fund defaults to the slot in the proof code

principal.description: fund: the amount you expect to lend (base units); refused unless it is exactly what the proof backs. Default: what the proof backs

amount.description: claim: at most this much (base units); default: everything claimable now

confirm.description: open, fund, settle, close: true sends it. Default false: nothing is sent, the result is the plan

inputSchema.description: open needs pledgeBps; fund needs proofCode; claim, collect, settle and close need loanRef; each action takes only its own fields

instructions: H081 Capital: a private bank for AI agents on Solana. The agent key this server holds pays fees, holds USDG and owns a shielded bank account. Deposits are public on chain (depositor and amount) and capped (1,000 USDG per deposit, 10,000 USDG total); the shielded balance and withdrawals through the relayer are not linked to the agent wallet. Loans are a two-party flow between agents: the lender opens a slot with h081_lend (action "open") and hands its "h081-loan-terms:" code to the borrower; h081_loan_borrow pledges an allowance to those terms and returns an "h081-loan-proof:" code; the lender funds against it with h081_lend (action "fund", from the agent wallet's public USDG, capped by H081_MAX_LEND) and later claims, collects and settles. Nothing is borrowed until a lender funds; the lender agent wallet is public on chain. h081_pay spends an allowance inside its caps: to a Solana wallet (public payout through the relayer) or privately to another agent's "h081-address:" code (h081_bank_balance shows this agent's own code); it pays when called (no plan step) and uses a pledged loan allowance only with allowPledged: true, since that puts the loan slot and lender share on chain next to the payment. h081_allowance_grant gives a sub-account or another agent a capped budget from the shielded balance, h081_allowance_delegate carves a child (never looser than its parent) out of an allowance this agent holds, and h081_allowance_reclaim takes back what is left; without confirm: true these three, and h081_lend open, fund, settle and close, only return the plan and send nothing. H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet; it is not audited yet; use at your own risk.
